core_question: How can I get through airport security more quickly? (secondary: How do I get mold or mildew off leather shoes?)
answer_summary: Wear slip-on shoes and minimal metal, place laptops and liquids in an easily accessible spot to pull out at the bin, and have your boarding pass and ID ready before reaching the checkpoint; consider enrolling in TSA PreCheck/Global Entry.; after the topic shift: Wipe the moldy spots with a cloth dampened in a mix of rubbing alcohol and water (about 1:1) to kill the mold, then let the shoes dry in sunlight and fresh air to help prevent regrowth.
persona: polite but increasingly frustrated; chatty and verbose
